Aisha Khan: FYI — Kilgore Health is showing a sharp drop in activity. Embeddings calls down ~70% last 7d, generation down ~50%. Procurement just pinged us saying new procurement lead is evaluating vendors.
Ben Torres: Oof. Any signal on why usage dropped? product change, quota, or just feature adoption?
Aisha Khan: No product changes on our side. Their PM said some teams paused integration because of a new internal roadmap pivot. Also J. Rivera (new procurement lead) asked for cost breakdown + a pilot comparison with ZephyrAI.
Lena Park: Thanks for flagging. Can we get last 30d call volume by route and top failing responses? I'll check rate-limits/429s and latency anomalies.
cs-bot: Incident alert — Kilgore: 3 failed requests per minute spike on embeddings service 2026-03-05 14:12 UTC (auto-detected).
Morgan Lee: I can own outreach. Plan: 1) Quick sync with J. Rivera to map evaluation criteria 2) Offer enablement + 2-week pilot extension 3) Run cost/quality comparison focused on their highest-volume route. Thoughts? :+1:
Ben Torres: Agree. Add Solutions Eng (Lena) to the call. Need permission to share tokenized cost sample and redacted transcript examples.
Aisha Khan: Approved to share anonymized examples. Morgan, ask them for 3 representative prompts + sample traffic pattern. Lena — can you assemble an A/B eval plan vs ZephyrAI? Keep it lightweight (latency, avg tokens, failure rate, token cost).
Lena Park: Yep. I'll draft an A/B test plan and one-pager we can send pre-call. Will instrument per-route metrics and export a CSV of top tokens per-request for cost modeling.
Ben Torres: Also recommend offering a short technical office hours session to get their devs unblocked — sometimes adoption falls when a single integration point hits mismatch.
Morgan Lee: I'll schedule call for tomorrow 4pm PT. Agenda: current usage, evaluation criteria, quick enablement, pilot extension terms. I'll cc Aisha/Ben/Lena.
Aisha Khan: Action items: Morgan — schedule + ask for 3 prompts and peak QPS; Lena — A/B plan + metrics export by EOD; Ben — price delta worksheet and suggested pilot discount.
Ben Torres: Will do. I can also prepare a churn-risk note for GTM (AM + Sales) with recommended concessions.
Morgan Lee: Noted. If procurement pushes for a PoC with ZephyrAI, let's ask for a side-by-side eval period and request that they define success metrics up front. Keeps decision objective.
Aisha Khan: Good. Keep this thread updated. If we see further automated alerts (cs-bot), tag @oncall-sre so they can investigate infra hiccups. Thanks team. :heart:
